plugins.name: astro-cli-commands
plugins.description: Astro Commands gives Codex a maintained, command-first operating contract for Astro projects: inspect the installed CLI, prefer official capabilities, and verify version drift before acting.

interface.shortDescription: Use Astro's current CLI capabilities first.
interface.longDescription: A maintained command-first operating contract for Astro projects. It makes Codex inspect the installed Astro CLI, prefer supported framework commands over improvised workflows, and verify version drift before planning or executing changes.
capabilities: Background dev and preview server handling
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Astro Commands before planning this Astro task.

skills.shortDescription: Use Astro's current CLI capabilities first.

plugins.name: prettier-after-edit
plugins.description: Format files edited by Codex with Prettier after each change, preferring project-local binaries and falling back to global PATH when needed.

interface.shortDescription: Auto-format files after each Codex edit.
interface.longDescription: This plugin formats the file reported by supported Codex edit events with Prettier. It always checks for a project-local Prettier first, then falls back to a PATH-visible global executable. If no executable is available, it skips cleanly without error.
capabilities: Per-event file formatting after edits and writes
Project-local Prettier preference with global fallback
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Prettier After Edit to format changed files after supported Codex edits.

skills.shortDescription: Auto-format files after each Codex edit.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use Prettier After Edit to format changed files after supported Codex edits.

plugins.name: doc-keeper
plugins.description: Keep changelogs and architecture decision records aligned with completed work, release preparation, and explicit decisions through evidence-based, infrastructure-aware procedures.

interface.longDescription: DocKeeper gives Codex an evidence-first closeout, release-preflight, and maintenance process for changelogs and architecture decision records. It detects existing infrastructure, preserves document ownership, and avoids invented history or unauthorized remote actions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use DocKeeper to maintain changelogs and ADRs, close out notable changes, or prepare release history.

skills.defaultPrompt: Use $doc-keeper to maintain changelogs and ADRs, close out notable changes, or prepare release history.
